caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #129: DESICCATED

desiccated (adjective): completely dried out; lacking life.

✅ In a sentence: The desiccated riverbed cracked into thousands of tiles.
✅ Similar: dried, parched, dehydrated
✅ Remember it: A desiccant is the "do not eat" packet that keeps things dry.
